name: ip

knownFailures: should respond with a private ip
upstreamTests.knownFailuresReason: address('private', 'ipv6') depends on the machine's network interfaces; it fails identically on the unpatched 2.0.1 when the host has a public IPv6 address.

summary: isPrivate/isPublic/isLoopback parse addresses numerically, so alternative spellings (127.1, 012.1.2.3, 0254.020.0.1, 017700000001, ::fFFf:127.0.0.1, 000:0:0000::01) are no longer reported as public. Fixes CVE-2024-29415, CVE-2025-59436 and node-ip#170.
